## Architecture

### Database schema (Postgres)

The Postgres tables on Neon, how they connect, and the sync flow. Identity, entries and files are built (backend/db/migrations); thing, detail and sensor tables are still proposals, built with their features (milestone M9). The .mmd files are the diagram sources, schema-tables.md lists each table's columns and the agreed rules.

- Open: `docs/architecture/backend/db-schema/lauwell-data-schema.html`
- Also: `architecture/backend/db-schema/schema-er.mmd`, `architecture/backend/db-schema/schema-flow.mmd`, `architecture/backend/db-schema/schema-tables.md`

### C4 diagrams (levels 1 to 3)

Context, containers and components of the app, Firebase and Postgres. The .mmd files are the sources, the README says how they were drawn.

- Open: `docs/architecture/c4/lauwell-c4.html`
- Also: `architecture/c4/`

### Shared foundation: things, acts and links

The two families of records (things and acts) and how records link to each other. Settled and built (2026-11-09, milestone M4); mood moved to these tables on 2026-11-11.

- Open: `docs/architecture/backend/shared-foundation.md`

### Feature modules and on/off toggles

How the app is split into feature modules, how each is switched on or off, and the four-tab navigation.

- Open: `docs/architecture/feature-modules-and-toggles.md`

### TrackAid review

Lessons from the earlier TrackAid prototype; summarised in PLAN.md under Decisions.
